line: Six of Disks: Crowley's title, planetary attribution and place on the Tree, with his account of the card.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Title and planet, as the chapter gives them (pdf 178, 232).

quotes.quote: The Six of Disks is called Success
The Moon in Taurus rules the card

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: The Sixes belong to Tiphareth (pdf 177), and the card's chapter names the Number Six as Tiphareth (pdf 232).

quotes.quote: These cards are attributed to Tiphareth.
The Number Six, Tiphareth, as before, represents the full harmonious establishment of the Energy of the Element.
